chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti narrated from ʿAbd al-Karim ibn ʿAmr, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, from al-ʿAbd al-Salih عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A young girl who does not menstruate, though others like her do menstruate, and her husband divorces her? He said: Her waiting period is three months.

key_terms.الْجَارِيَةُ: a young female, here referring to a young woman
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ: three lunar months as the legal waiting period

ai.seo_question: What is the ʿiddah of a young woman who does not menstruate though others her age do?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the ʿiddah of a young woman who does not menstruate even though women of her age normally do. The Imam عليه السلام rules that if her husband divorces her, her waiting period is three months.
